ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circle with P as the center, and points G, E, N, and M are all on the circle. G is on the upper left, E is on the upper right, N is on the lower right, and M is on the lower left; the order around the circle is G-E-N-M. Segment GN passes through center P, so GN is a diameter. The figure also shows chord GE, EN, NM, MG, as well as the segments from M to E and from G to N. The problem gives m arc EN = 66, and m∠GPM = 89. Reasoning: Because ∠GPM is a central angle, the measure of its intercepted minor arc GM is equal to 89. Also because GN is a diameter, the semicircular arc from G to N through M has measure 180, so arc MN = 180 - arc GM = 180 - 89 = 91. The arc measure of the whole circle is 360, and it is divided in order around the circle into arcs GE, EN, NM, MG, so arc GE = 360 - 66 - 91 - 89 = 114. Angle GME is an inscribed angle and intercepts arc GE, therefore m∠GME = 114 / 2 = 57.

raw_record.question_text: In $\odot P$, $m\widehat{EN}=66$ and $m\angle GPM=89$. Find $m\angle GME$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: G, E, N, and M lie on circle P, and the drawn chord GN passes through the center P, so GN is a diameter. The points occur around the circle in the order G-E-N-M. From the text, m arc EN = 66 and central angle GPM = 89, so minor arc GM = 89. Because GN is a diameter, the semicircle from G to N through M has measure 180, so arc MN = 180 - 89 = 91. Then use the full-circle arc sum: arc GE = 360 - arc EN - arc MN - arc GM = 360 - 66 - 91 - 89 = 114. Finally, angle GME is an inscribed angle intercepting arc GE, so m angle GME = 114/2 = 57.

图像描述：图中是以 P 为圆心的圆，点 G、E、N、M 都在圆上。G 在左上方，E 在右上方，N 在右下方，M 在左下方，圆周顺序为 G-E-N-M。线段 GN 经过圆心 P，因此 GN 是直径。图中还画出了 chord GE、EN、NM、MG，以及从 M 到 E、从 G 到 N 的线段。题目给出 m弧EN = 66，且 m∠GPM = 89。

推理：因为 ∠GPM 是圆心角，所以它所对的 minor arc GM 的度数等于 89。又因为 GN 是直径，所以从 G 到 N 经过 M 的半圆弧度数为 180，因此弧 MN = 180 - 弧 GM = 180 - 89 = 91。整个圆的弧度数为 360，并且按圆周顺序分成弧 GE、EN、NM、MG，所以弧 GE = 360 - 66 - 91 - 89 = 114。角 GME 是圆周角，截弧为 GE，因此 m∠GME = 114 / 2 = 57。
